name: vibesdk-github-export-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda for exporting an aws/agent-runtime session's git history (aws/git-storage) to a real GitHub repository -- port of worker/api/controllers/githubExporter/controller.ts + worker/services/github/GitHubService.ts's push path, reduced in scope (no cached-token fast path, no remote-status diffing, no README deploy-button rewrite -- see this package's README). Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../github-export-lambda.zip handler.js package.json
